prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: The parent's density-weight "damp toward 1 early" is a blunt instrument — it uniformly weakens the density gradient in the first 50 iterations regardless of whether overflow is actually rising. Instead, I gate the relaxation on *observed* overflow: only let the density weight relax (clamp to 0.5*LOWER_PCOF) when the current overflow is not above the previous one, so that when cells are being pushed into congested regions (overflow rising) the density pressure is allowed to grow normally and clear the congestion, while in the steady/freeing regime it keeps the wirelength-friendly relaxation. This preserves the parent's TNS gains but reduces the congestion-driven detours that later cost TNS.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.588 robust(mean-std)=+0.170 min_case=+0.160 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.214 dWNS=+11.1% dTNS=+28.1% overflow~96
  bp-ng45: score=+0.214 dWNS=+15.8% dTNS=+25.0% overflow~92
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.160 dWNS=+15.4% dTNS=+16.4% overflow~140
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: gating density relaxation on observed overflow improved all three cases (score +0.160 to +0.214, all valid). Gains concentrate in TNS (up to +28.1%) with WNS also positive, consistent with reduced congestion-driven detours. Ariane133 and bp show the largest TNS moves; bp_fe smaller but still positive. Mechanism: allowing density pressure to grow when overflow rises clears congestion earlier, preserving wirelength-friendly relaxation otherwise. Next step: sweep the relaxation factor (0.5×LOWER_PCOF) and the overflow comparison window to test robustness and find the best trade-off.
